manaNeeded: {1}{R}{G} plus enough mana to pay for Abby's commander tax
notablePrerequisites: Abby's commander tax is at least {4}.
description:
Cast Abby from the command zone by paying {1}{R}{G} plus commander tax.
Abby triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Cordyceps Infected creature tokens.
When the Cordyceps Infected tokens enter, Mana Echoes triggers that many times, adding {C} for each Fungus and/or Zombie you control for each trigger.
Resolve Abby, giving control of it to an opponent.
Activate Goblin Bombardment four times by sacrificing four Cordyceps Infected tokens, dealing 4 damage to Abby.
Abby dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness. Choose to return it to the command zone from your graveyard.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing two Cordyceps Infected tokens, adding {R}{G}.
Repeat.
